DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"HDFCLIFE"}, 'nifty50_stocks'[NSE_Ticker])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'sector_peers'[Sector],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"AverageReturn_1Y_Pct", CALCULATE(AVERAGE('sector_peers'[Return_1Y_Pct])),
			"Sector_Bar_Colour", IGNORE('sector_peers'[Sector Bar Colour])
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [AverageReturn_1Y_Pct], 0, 'sector_peers'[Sector], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[AverageReturn_1Y_Pct] DESC, 'sector_peers'[Sector]

DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
	TREATAS({"HDFCLIFE"}, 'nifty50_stocks'[NSE_Ticker])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(__DS0FilterTable, "Sector", IGNORE('stock_prices'[Sector]))

DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
	TREATAS({"HDFCLIFE"}, 'nifty50_stocks'[NSE_Ticker])

EVALUATE

DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
	TREATAS({"HDFCLIFE"}, 'nifty50_stocks'[NSE_Ticker])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
		__DS0FilterTable,
		"Sector_Avg_1Y_Return__", IGNORE('sector_peers'[Sector Avg 1Y Return %]),
		"Stock_1Y_Return__", IGNORE('stock_prices'[Stock 1Y Return %])
	)

DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
	TREATAS({"HDFCLIFE"}, 'nifty50_stocks'[NSE_Ticker])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(__DS0FilterTable, "Company_Name", IGNORE('stock_prices'[Company Name]))

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"HDFCLIFE"}, 'nifty50_stocks'[NSE_Ticker])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(
				SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
					'sector_peers'[Ticker],
					'sector_peers'[Company],
					__DS0FilterTable,
					"SumReturn_1Y_Pct", CALCULATE(SUM('sector_peers'[Return_1Y_Pct])),
					"SumBeta", CALCULATE(SUM('sector_peers'[Beta])),
					"SumSharpe_Ratio", CALCULATE(SUM('sector_peers'[Sharpe_Ratio])),
					"Peer_In_Sector", IGNORE('sector_peers'[Peer In Sector])
				)
			),
			[Peer_In_Sector] = 1
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(501, __DS0Core, [SumReturn_1Y_Pct], 0, 'sector_peers'[Ticker], 1, 'sector_peers'[Company], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[SumReturn_1Y_Pct] DESC, 'sector_peers'[Ticker], 'sector_peers'[Company]
